sharedRules.name: Martial Ka'tah
sharedRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units with this ability are **readied**. While a friendly unit is **readied**, you can select one of the **ka-tah abilities** for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer **readied**.

Each **ka-tah ability** will tell you when that **ka-tah ability** can be used and the effects that **ka-tah ability** has on the unit using it.

rules.name: Gilded Guardians
rules.description:

**Favoured Ka'tah**: SALVUS
Additional Effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +6" R.

rules.name: Instruments of the Emperor's Wrath
rules.description:
Friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units can re-roll **charge rolls**.

**Favoured Ka'tah**: DACATARAI

rules.name: Heralds of the Throne
rules.description:
Friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units have **Fights First**.

**Favoured Ka'tah**: CONSERVAI
Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an **advance/fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being **eligible to start an action**.

rules.name: Magna Imperator
rules.description:
When a friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ unit is selected to attack, that unit's attacks can:
- Re-roll one **hit roll**.
- Re-roll one **wound roll**.

**Favoured Ka'tah**: RENDAX
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy ^^**Monster/Vehicle**^^ unit **engaged** with your unit and roll one D6:
- On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 **mortal wound**.
- On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds**.
- On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 **mortal wounds**.

rules.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rules.description:
While a friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ unit (excluding ^^**Monster/Vehicle**^^ units) is within range of an **objective**, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to **wound rolls**.

**Favoured Ka'tah**: KAPTARIS
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit **engaged** with your unit. That enemy unit must make a ^^**battle-shock roll**^^, with -1 to that ^^**battle-shock roll**^^. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

rules.name: Talon Sortie
rules.description:
When a friendly ^^**Adeptus Custodes**^^ units makes a **fall-back move**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to charge**.

**Favoured Ka'tah**: CALISTUS
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

rules.name: Blinding Light
rules.description: Each time a unit is hit by this weapon, it is blinded until the start of your next turn. While a unit is blinded, each time a model in that units makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, the bearer can deploy the Epoch Auspice. If it does, until the end of the battle round, each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, when the bearer is selected to fight, it can activate the Mortis Gyre. If it does, until that fight is resolved, melee attacks made by the model that target an **^^Infantry^^** unit have the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, at the end of any of your phases, the bearer can use the Twilight Pallium. If it does, remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units. The bearer's unit is not eligible to charge in a turn in which it was set up in this manner unless it is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
